concepts.def: Slum Rehabilitation Authority redevelops slums into multi-storey flats.
Mumbai Urban Transport Project upgrades trains and roads.
Plan to transform Mumbai into a world-class city by 2027.
New Mumbai Metro is cutting road traffic and emissions.
Bandra-Worli cable bridge that cuts cross-city journey times.
Balances economy, society and environment for the future. 🏗

walkthroughs.body_html:
The SRA redevelops slum land.

Residents get free flats and developers build private flats on the spare land.

Critics say culture and businesses get lost.

MUTP targets the transport crisis.

It widens roads, modernises trains and supports the new Metro.

The Bandra-Worli Sea Link cuts a 1 hour trip to about 10 minutes.

Vision Mumbai aims for 2027.

Goals include green space, jobs, schools and slum clearance.

It tries to balance economic, social and environmental goals.
